model.title: STOP Payments Fraud Act of 2026
model.meta: Financial Services Committee · Rep. Young Kim (R-CA)

summary.text: The bill would amend federal banking law to create exceptions allowing banks to hold funds longer when they suspect a check or wire transfer is fraudulent, rather than being required to make deposited funds available within standard timeframes. It aims to give financial institutions more flexibility to prevent fraud losses while protecting depositors from schemes involving fake or stolen payment instruments.
